description: Find snapcn Remotion components for a scene by describing the beat in plain English. Returns ranked candidates with natural length, vibe and use/avoid notes. Use this instead of writing animation code.

max_frames.description: Drop candidates longer than this frame budget (30fps).

query.description: What the shot must DO, not a component name. e.g. 'swap one pricing number for another', 'show our CLI install command', 'burned-in captions over a talking head'. Pass an empty string with a category to list that category.

tier.description: Which half of the catalogue. Pro components install with the user's key and are the premium scenes; free ones install with no key at all.

name: snapcn_search_components
title: Search snapcn components
